description: This file defines a CSS parser and manipulator class for handling CSS strings and objects, including parsing, merging, diffing, namespacing, and style element creation.

classes.name: CSSParser
classes.description: A class providing methods to parse, manipulate, and generate CSS styles and objects.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes CSS comments from a CSS string.

methods.name: parseCSS
methods.description: Parses a CSS string into an array of CSSObject structures.

methods.name: parseRules
methods.description: Parses CSS rules into an array of CSSRule objects.

methods.name: findCorrespondingRule
methods.description: Finds a rule matching a directive and optional value.

methods.name: findBySelector
methods.description: Finds CSSObjects by selector, optionally merging duplicates.

methods.name: deleteBySelector
methods.description: Deletes CSSObjects with a specific selector.

methods.name: cssDiff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two CSSObjects.

methods.name: intelligentMerge
methods.description: Merges two CSSObject arrays, prioritizing one over the other.

methods.name: intelligentCSSPush
methods.description: Pushes a CSSObject into an array, merging with existing entries.

methods.name: getCSSForEditor
methods.description: Generates a formatted CSS string from CSSObjects for editing.

methods.name: getImports
methods.description: Retrieves all import statements from CSSObjects.

methods.name: getCSSOfRules
methods.description: Formats CSS rules into a string with indentation.

methods.name: applyNamespacing
methods.description: Applies a namespace to CSS selectors to prevent collisions.

methods.name: clearNamespacing
methods.description: Removes namespace prefixes from CSS selectors.

methods.name: createStyleElement
methods.description: Creates or updates a style element in the document with provided CSS.
